name: Proofpoint - Known Malicious Attachment in Mailbox
xql_query:
dataset = proofpoint_tap_raw
| filter _log_type = "message-blocked" and threatsInfoMap contains "MALWARE"
| alter all_recipients = recipient
| alter recipient_expanded = json_extract_array(recipient, "$")
| arrayexpand recipient_expanded
| alter recipient = json_extract_scalar(recipient_expanded, "$")
description: A message carrying a known-malicious attachment (Proofpoint MALWARE threat category) was blocked before delivery.
alert_name: Proofpoint - Known Malicious Attachment in Mailbox
alert_description:
What fired: Proofpoint blocked an inbound email whose attachment matched a known malware threat (message-blocked, threatsInfoMap=MALWARE).

Why it matters: a user was targeted with weaponized content. The block is good, but it confirms active targeting and the sender/campaign may retry or hit other users.

Investigate:
  - Review the mapped recipient, sender, sender IP, subject and threat details on this alert.
  - Check whether the same sender/campaign reached other users (see the campaign rules) or was DELIVERED (not blocked) to anyone.
  - Consider blocking the sender/domain.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1566.001 - Spearphishing Attachment (TA0001 - Initial Access).
